notes:
Account status: CLOSED-LOST (lost to FastStreamAI). Primary technical blocker was latency/streaming behavior — POC did not meet Laguna's target p95 for token streaming and conversational latency.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (AE Maya). Opportunity qualified; use-case = live voice + chat support. Target customer-facing p95 <= 300ms for short-turn responses.
- 2025-12-05: Demo (streaming demo) + follow-up Qs. SE (Carlos) ran basic streaming demo; initial artifacts in Drive (demo recording).
- 2026-01-18: POC kickoff — 4-week evaluation. We stood up dedicated GPUs (trial), integrated streaming SDK into their React web client.
- 2026-02-02: Mid-POC load test: observed p95 ~450-600ms on conversational flows with 2k concurrent users (their sim). Streaming chunk latency spikes caused UI "jank" and partial-token delays.
- 2026-02-10: Deep dive call (ff-2026-02-10-6172). SE walked through traces. Key findings: KV cache miss amplification on long contexts, batch sizing causing head-of-line latency, tokenization overhead in our runtime path for streaming.
- 2026-02-16: Engineering suggested mitigations: smaller batch windows, aggressive prefix caching, test quantized model variant, route heavy flows to lower-cost non-streaming path. Laguna performed tests; results: small improvements but still >300ms p95 for critical flows.
- 2026-02-20: Procurement stalled — internal champion (Sr. Eng Manager) left team. Finance paused new infra spend (hiring/budget freeze). Laguna began parallel evaluation of FastStreamAI who delivered better streaming throughput in their tests.
- 2026-02-25: Final call — customer signaled they would move forward with competitor. No contract signed with Redwood.

Technical notes / root causes observed:
- Target: p95 <= 300ms for short-turn chat/voice streaming.
- Observed: p95 450-600ms in POC at realistic concurrency with their prompt set and 8k context windows.
- Streaming issues: intermittent chunking delays, partial token flushes; client experienced long gaps between token events.
- Attempts made: dedicated instance sizing changes, batching config tuning, prefix KV caching, quantized model fallbacks. Improvements insufficient under their worst-case paths.

Why lost / non-technical factors:
- Competitive: FastStreamAI provided a specialized streaming runtime optimized for low-latency incremental token delivery and quoted lower per-conversation cost.
- Org: internal champion left during procurement; replacement deprioritized project.
- Budget: Q1 hiring/budget freeze at Laguna delayed decision window and revenue commit.

Next recommended follow-ups (for Redwood internal playbook):
- Mark account closed-lost; schedule 6-month cadence to re-open after their roadmap refresh (watch for: re-org hires, budget re-opens).
- Share engineering post-mortem with products team: collect traces (INF-4123, PERF-2210) and validate streaming token emission path; consider targeted perf optimization workstream for p95 streaming under medium-high concurrency.
- Competitive intel: request specifics from Laguna on FastStreamAI test harness (we have partial details in thread-1676873-convo).
